notes.title: Gifts for the New Year!
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone Happy New Year, gifts are waiting for you from us! 
We want to inform you that soon 10 of our products will be free! Hurray! We want to do this from January 23th, 2023, 11:00 AM PST.[/b]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32998990/51b71fa00538e81edec58be917eb17370ed7e305.png[/img]

[b]In honor of the fifth anniversary of our games, the following products will be free:
1. Cyberemo 2007 Director's Cut
2. Cyberemo 2007 Soundtrack
3. SOK PRO Upgrade
4. SOK MAX PRO
5. SOK MIN PRO
6. SOK PRO MAX
7. SOK PRO MIN
8. SOK PRO SEX
9. Welcome Back To 2007 2 Director's Cut
10. Welcome Back To 2007 2 Soundtrack[/b]

[b]If you have already bought the add-ons, then you can make a refund through the standard procedure, or you can leave everything as it is and we will be grateful to you =)

Stay tuned. Thanks![/b]

[h1][b]We are also pleased to inform you about the acquisition of the studio Corduroy Games and all the games of this developer =)[/b][/h1]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32998990/ccb90ec252860782e661f7c0a8b0be0345335adc.png[/img]



[i]After a long collaboration with Corduroy Games as a publisher and developer, we decided to combine our efforts under the Siberian Mouse brand.
We have heard that it is now fashionable to buy developers for exorbitant amounts, so we are acquiring Corduroy Games and all its games for 23 billion torn hats.
The deal began at the end of May 2022 and now, in September, the deal is completely closed and we are happy to inform you about it!
We are very happy to welcome new faces and new games to our ranks![/i]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32998990/d8edd381848f6bf3ee53b4d5236cb6e38872ae9d.png[/img]


[h1][b]Add our new game to your wishlist:[/b][/h1]
